transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to cut through the biased early data and understand true transmissibility and severity before committing to extreme measures.

actions.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to cut through the biased early data and understand true transmissibility and severity before committing to extreme measures.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: We must pre-position ventilators, PPE, and test kits now so we are not caught short if this virus turns severe, without yet shuttering the economy.

actions.rationale: We must pre-position ventilators, PPE, and test kits now so we are not caught short if this virus turns severe, without yet shuttering the economy.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Launching a crash public-private vaccine and therapeutics program immediately gives us the best shot at a long-term solution and signals resolve to markets and the public.

actions.rationale: Launching a crash public-private vaccine and therapeutics program immediately gives us the best shot at a long-term solution and signals resolve to markets and the public.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Daily, honest, data-driven updates will build public trust, counter misinformation, and let Americans see exactly what we know and what we do not.

actions.rationale: Daily, honest, data-driven updates will build public trust, counter misinformation, and let Americans see exactly what we know and what we do not.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard empowers states, hospitals, and citizens to make informed decisions while we work to fill knowledge gaps.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard empowers states, hospitals, and citizens to make informed decisions while we work to fill knowledge gaps.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Focusing early federal guidance on shielding the elderly and high-risk groups limits mortality while keeping broader society functioning as we learn more.

actions.rationale: Focusing early federal guidance on shielding the elderly and high-risk groups limits mortality while keeping broader society functioning as we learn more.

params.rationale: We need Congress aligned now on emergency funding and statutory authorities so we can move fast if the situation escalates in the coming weeks.
